role: a checkpoint8 view of the CP8-A correction. The authoritative record is the file hashed below; this one adds the naming audit and the checkpoint-level reading.
reason: d6/1 aggregated every (arm, condition) block over all 72 stored cells, including the 12 unrotated control rows, and published a Precision@10 under the name class_recall_at_k. Both are reading errors baked into the summary; neither is a new experiment.

definitions.rotation_only: the headline. Cells whose query was actually turned, so every rotation statistic is measured on poses that can fail.
definitions.unrotated_control: diagnostic only. The 0-degree poses, reported apart because a control cell asks an unrotated question: it can show the pipeline is wired correctly, and it cannot show that a wrapper survives a turn.

views.arithmetic: 12 queries x 5 rotated slots = 60 rotated cells per (arm, condition), plus 12 0-degree controls = the 72 rows the /1 block averaged

metric_definitions.precision_at_10: same-class share OF THE RETURNED Top-10: hits / min(k, n_returned). This is the number /1 published as class_recall_at_k, unchanged, correctly named
metric_definitions.recall_at_10: share OF THE RETAINED RELEVANT CANDIDATES that reached the Top-10: hits / n_same_class_kept for that query and condition. The denominator is per query (2, 3 or 4 under T2 here), never a constant
metric_definitions.recall_undefined: a cell with n_same_class_kept == 0 has no relevant candidate left to find, so recall_at_10 is undefined; such cells are counted in recall_at_10_undefined_cells and excluded from the mean instead of being written down as a 0.0 failure
metric_definitions.ndcg: unchanged arithmetic; ndcg_at_10_n_scored now states how many cells contributed, because NDCG@K already skipped cells that found nothing relevant
metric_definitions.class_relevance: MPEG-7 category labels are a relevance proxy for automated metrics only. They are not human similarity judgements and are never presented as such.

independent_check_from_raw_ranks.source: d6_top10_hits.csv, one row per rank, counted by is_same_class
independent_check_from_raw_ranks.note: The stored per-rank table covers the primary condition only, which is where the headline is quoted from; T0 and T1 keep the ratio-based recompute.

naming_audit_B4.what_it_measured: same-class share of the returned Top-K, i.e. Precision@K -- the numerator was right, the name was a recall word on a precision formula
naming_audit_B4.consequence: no method got faster, more accurate or more stable because of the rename; a reader who took class_recall_at_k for recall was reading a harder question than the one that had been answered
naming_audit_B4.legacy_value_still_means: precision_at_10, unchanged, over the same cells
